security_implications: The chunk aggregates six bus‑integrity error signals into alerts[0], implementing the SEC_CM: BUS.INTEGRITY requirement. When NumAlerts > 1, higher alert bits are left unassigned (U1), which could suppress or corrupt alert reporting. The alert_test assignment (U2) derives from register fields; an incorrect width could leave some alert channels untestable. Any failure in these integrity error signals or their aggregation may allow corrupted transactions to pass undetected, directly violating the bus integrity security objective.
